mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.5% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL below 2.0% and FEDFUNDS below 0.1% indicates stable inflation and low rates that reduce equity risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS meet the threshold conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 950 thousand units signal robust construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and retail sales, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during HOUST > 950 periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 index level indicates manufacturing sector strength that correlates with rising corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal savings exceeding $440,000 million reflects strong household balance sheets that increase discretionary spending and equity market demand, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 440000.

mechanism_narrative: Combined PAYEMS growth above 139,000 thousand and HOUST above 950 thousand units indicates labor market strength driving housing demand, which accelerates economic momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% triggers central bank rate hike expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods.
